gloss: calling at a port; port of call

definitions.gloss: calling at a port; making a port call; stopping at a port
definitions.explanation: When a ship stops at a port during a voyage, either for refueling, loading cargo, or allowing passengers to disembark temporarily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄港地|きこうち}→寄港地：17886_kikouchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧です。
examples.english: The next port of call is Kobe.

examples.japanese: クルーズ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧{港|こう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄港|きこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A cruise ship called at the port of Yokohama.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{航路|こうろ}→航路：13972_kouro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄港|きこう}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: This route heads to the destination while calling at three ports along the way.

notes:
Used specifically for ships stopping at ports. Not used for aircraft or other vehicles. Used as a noun or suru-verb ({寄港|きこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{寄港地|きこうち}→寄港地：17886_kikouchi⟧: port of call
- {寄港|きこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to call at a port
- {寄港|きこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be scheduled to call at a port
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{寄港|きこう}: emergency port call

WATCH OUT:
Several words share the reading きこう:
- ⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: climate
- ⟦{機構|きこう}→機構：02784_kikou⟧: mechanism, organization
- ⟦{寄稿|きこう}→寄稿：17076_kikou⟧: contributing an article
- ⟦{紀行|きこう}→紀行：13823_kikou⟧: travelogue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧: entering a port — arriving at the final destination port
- ⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧: leaving port — departing from a port
- {寄港|きこう}: a temporary stop at a port during a voyage
